Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the MAP doc you sent last week. Sonia and I did a quick run-through of the proposed acceptance criteria and have a couple of asks before we lock the schedule: 

- Can Redwood provide a concrete latency profile (p90/p99) for the evaluation workload we discussed (50 concurrent short prompts + 10 long-form summarization tasks)?
- For data handling, we need a short note on redaction/PII handling during inference; procurement will need it for the SOW.
- Sonia flagged a concern about model drift checks during the trial — is there an automated way to snapshot model outputs for audit?

Sonia and I are free to meet Tue afternoon. If you want to propose a compact checklist, we can sign off quickly and push the PO through.

Ari
Head of Integrations | Finera Health

Ari — thanks, this is helpful. Quick replies inline and a short plan below.

- Latency profile: we will run the exact evaluation harness you described and share p50/p90/p99 for 1) baseline single-model, 2) quantized variant, 3) cached warm-run. Karthik will own the run.
- PII handling: Redwood Private will be configured to redact user-entered PII from logs by default for the trial; I attached a short checklist and our standard redaction note. Procurement can reference that in the SOW.
- Drift snapshots: we can enable periodic output snapshots tied to your eval set; Marissa will create a small pipeline that stores anonymized outputs to the shared Drive link.

Plan (proposed):
1) Tue 2026-03-17 3:00pm PT: 30m checkpoint to agree final acceptance checklist (aim: sign-off same day) — Vanessa/Karthik/Marissa/Sonia/Ari
2) Wed 3/18–Fri 3/20: Redwood runs evaluation harness and delivers latency report + snapshot sample
3) Mon 3/22: Acceptance review call and decision

Action owners (initial):
- Karthik: latency runs + environment config (due 2026-03-20)
- Marissa: snapshot/export pipe + sample outputs (due 2026-03-19)
- Neha: coordinate SOW wording with procurement (due 2026-03-18)

Attachments: RWI-Finera-MAP-v3.xlsx (MAP with checkpoints), POC-acceptance-checklist.pdf

I can take the Tue slot if that works — proposing calendar invite now.

Thanks,

Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC gate - latency runs and acceptance prep

Ari / Sonia — ran the evaluation harness yesterday and attaching summarized outputs (see Drive link). Key highlights: 

- Workload: 50 short concurrent prompts (avg 24 tokens), 10 long summaries (~450 tokens) sampled from Finera test set
- p50/p90/p99 (baseline): 58ms / 210ms / 1.4s
- p50/p90/p99 (quantized): 62ms / 230ms / 1.6s
- Warm-cache scenario improved p99 to ~980ms for long summaries

Blockers / notes:
- We observed one outlier run tied to a cold-start on a GPU node; engineering will add a guard in the harness to exclude noisy initial samples for the acceptance report.
- Need confirmation from Finera on the exact acceptance threshold for p99 on long summaries (proposal: p99 <= 1.2s).

Next steps: final acceptance checklist doc attached to the Drive + I'll push a short changelog to the MAP spreadsheet tonight.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
